findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.peppolstatus.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_incidents, get_participant_joiners, list_anomalies · Private data: get_access_point · Public sink: get_summary, list_providers, get_participant_stats · Destructive: get_adoption.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_incidents, get_participant_joiners, list_anomalies · Private data: get_access_point · Public sink: get_summary, list_providers, get_participant_stats · Destructive: get_adoption

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
